item.title: The file that kept the light
item.description:
There is a file in this repo that nobody opens for pleasure: tools/routing.json. It is the map of every app — id, name, url, description, tags, folder, category, fields, status, and who consumes what. It reads like plumbing. Today it behaved like a lamp.

This is the story of a long polishing session that began with colours, went down into every app in apps/, and ended up re-mining that file from a side we had left in the dark. By the end, the plumbing was checking itself every time we publish.

item.title: A house for the theory, a voice for the slides
item.description:
Every long thought eventually needs two things: a house and a voice. A house, so you can walk from room to room and see how the ideas connect; a voice, so someone can stand at the door and tell you what is inside before you commit to reading all of it.

flove is building both. The slides are the most precious material we have — years of hand-drawn thinking, page after page, dense the way a seed is dense — and also the hardest to enter: you have to know where to look. The videos are the introduction, a spoken and visual doorway into them. The last stretch of work was preparation for exactly that: building the house the slides will live in, labelling the shelves, and wiring the first room so the voice has somewhere to speak from.

item.title: The tag cloud and the playlist: how Risa's frontend grew up
item.description: Risa is, at heart, two pieces of frontend. On the left, a floating cloud of tags — little chips that drift around, that you tap to filter the feed, that grow when you ask them to. On the right, the playlist — the player, the threads, the reactions, everything that happens when a laugh is actually listened to. Over the last month that frontend went through three lives: it was born, it was moved into a shared engine, and it was cleaned until anyone could fork it. This is the story of those two pieces across the versions — and the three names you need to keep straight: flove0 (the distro), risa1 (nick as tag), risa2 (the current one, on the shared libraries).
